key_path: `plaid register` opens Dashboard signup in browser (email, company info) -> verify email
`plaid login` browser auth; CLI stores tokens and fetches Sandbox client_id + secret automatically
real data: `plaid trial` application form (US/CA, free, 10 Items) -> approval -> `plaid keys fetch`; full Production needs company profile + security questionnaire

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_device_login: yes - `plaid login` (browser) auto-fetches API keys; `--json` output and predictable exit codes 'for agents'
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes - api.dashboard.plaid.com advertises registration_endpoint /oauth/register, PKCE S256, scope mcp:dashboard; also client_credentials token via /oauth/token
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: partial - /oauth/token mints MCP tokens from client_id/secret; keys fetched via CLI
agent_native_auth.scoped_restricted_keys: partial - separate Sandbox/Production secrets; OAuth scope mcp:dashboard
agent_native_auth.test_mode_sandbox: yes - Sandbox free on all accounts
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes - Trial plan free (10 production Items, teams created on/after 2026-04-15)

mcp.type: two servers: remote Dashboard MCP (production diagnostics/analytics: Item debugging, Link conversion, usage) and local Sandbox MCP (mock data, docs search, sandbox tokens)

remote.auth: OAuth (DCR) or Bearer token from /oauth/token client_credentials; Production-approved teams only

one_click: one-click install button in ai-coding-toolkit README

docs_for_agents.other: ai-coding-toolkit /rules for CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/Cursor rules; rate limits as JSON (plaid.com/data/rate-limits.json); AI assistant 'Bill' in Dashboard

score_justification: Agent-designed CLI that auto-fetches keys, OAuth-DCR MCP, rules files and sandbox MCP; only blocked by email signup and production approval.
best_practice: CLI `login` that pulls API keys into local config so the agent never handles copy-pasted secrets, with explicit agent-mode (--json, stderr diagnostics, exit codes).
biggest_gap: The remote MCP only works for Production-approved teams, so the zero-to-MCP path for a new developer is local-only.
